chunks.title: African Development Bank Group (AfDB) (AfDB) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: African Development Bank Group (AfDB) is a Multilateral Development Bank (MDB) headquartered in Côte d'Ivoire (Multilateral). At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Co-Chair of Electrify Now Finance Coalition (35-by-35 Pledge); Africa Pavilion (A240); launched RESILAFRICA food systems flagship. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Co-leading global Electrify Now Finance Coalition with World Bank + RESILAFRICA food systems resilience & African climate finance mobilization. Source verification: https://www.ipsnews.net/2026/11/cop31-african-development-bank-to-co-lead-global-electrification-finance-initiative/.

chunks.title: AfDB Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: African Development Bank Group (AfDB) provides the following climate financing instruments: Sovereign Loan, Non-Sovereign Debt, Equity, Partial Risk Guarantee, Concessional Finance (ADF), Climate Adaptation Grant. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 10,000,000 to USD 300,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Sovereign/Government, Large Corporate, Project SPV, Financial Intermediary, Municipality.

chunks.title: AfDB Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by African Development Bank Group (AfDB): Electrification & Grid, Renewable Energy, Sustainable Agriculture & Water, Climate Adaptation & Resilience, Nature-Based Solutions. Target geographic focus includes: Africa, Sub-Saharan Africa, North Africa. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: AfDB Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete AfDB's application form: African Regional Member Country host jurisdiction; AfDB Integrated Safeguards System (ISS) & EIA; Climate Safeguards System (CSS) & Paris Alignment; Alignment with Electrify Now / RESILAFRICA / African NDCs. Explicit exclusion rules: Coal-fired power generation; Non-African host projects. Official application portal: https://www.afdb.org/en/topics-and-sectors/initiatives-partnerships/climate-change.

chunks.title: AfDB Form Template: Multilateral Development Bank (MDB) Climate Project Concept Note
chunks.text: African Development Bank Group (AfDB) uses the 'Multilateral Development Bank (MDB) Climate Project Concept Note' workflow governed by Joint MDB Paris Alignment Methodology (BB1 Mitigation / BB2 Adaptation) & Environmental/Social Framework. Typical review timeline is 6–16 weeks (Concept Clearance -> Appraisal -> Board Approval). Form sections required: 1. Identification, 2. Strategic Alignment, 3. Financial Structuring, 4. Climate & Technical Rationale, 5. Safeguards & Governance, 6. Execution & Risks, 7. Executive Summary.
